modules.module_title: Inspect and prepare the methane extraction unit for operation

pcs.pc_description: check various controls, pressure gauges, pump and allied components, hydraulic fracture, compressor, gas separator and water separator, back pressure regulator, piping system etc. for proper functioning and any defect
ensure that all meters, gauges etc. are calibrated
check the direction of rotation of motor is corresponding to the regulated rotation direction of pump
check the condition of inlet and outlet valves and ensure that they are working properly and in normal state
check the pipe system and other parts such as anchor bolt, flange sealing gasket and other bolts for proper working and good condition
check all foundation bolts and outlet pipework bolts for appropriate tightness and condition
ensure all electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, sealant and lubrication systems (as applicable) are connected and operational
maintain the operation and maintenance logbook to detail all activities conducted before starting the operation
report defects precisely to the supervisor if beyond scope of his/her role

modules.module_title: Start and operate the methane extraction unit

pcs.pc_description: open the inlet valve and fully close the outlet valve before starting the pump
start the extraction unit (pump and separators) and slowly open the outlet valve until the pump reaches the desired flow
check the pressure gauge to ensure that the pump reaches the required outlet pressure
stop the pump, and take the corrective actions as per SOP
monitor the gauges for bearing temperature, excessive vibration, and noise during the operation
shut down the pump immediately, if there is no pressure or low pressure or pump exceeds normal levels and take the corrective action as per SOP
monitor the operation of gas separator and ensure that it is extracting the methane and water contaminants properly and transferring them through their respective pipes
monitor the process parameters by reading the various gauges and correct them if not within standards
check the oil level at regular intervals
observe any gas leakage during the operation and stop the extraction unit immediately, if found
monitor the operation of complete extraction unit and record the operational data as per the frequency in the control plan
close the outlet valve, but ensure that the pump runs in this condition for no more than a few seconds
stop the complete extraction unit
maintain and complete all required documentation clearly, concisely as per SOP

modules.module_title: Repair and maintain the methane extraction unit

pcs.pc_description: perform basic health check-up of methane extraction unit as specified in the maintenance checklist
replenish coolants and lubricants as per SOP
clean dirt and dust from areas around close clearances, bearing housings, separators and motors
check coupling alignment and re-align if necessary

check the methane extraction unit parts i.e. motor, pump, gas separator, water separator, back pressure regulator, seals, auxiliary supplies e.g. heating/cooling (if fitted), wiring harness, connectors etc. for proper functioning to find out root cause of the problems like any leakage, short circuit in parts, breakage of wires and clamps, etc. and discuss the same with senior if required
check for unusual noise vibration and bearing temperatures in the extraction unit
check the separators, pump and piping, seal chamber and stuffing box etc. for leaks
check the instrument panel and control gauge to identify out of range readings to find the defect/cause of failure
replace/change the spare parts and consumables of the extraction unit as per the schedule
ensure proper lock out and tag out of methane extraction unit to avoid any untoward incident triggered due to unknowingly operation of machine / system under maintenance
assess when the problem is beyond his competence and report the problem to suitably qualified/designated and competent personnel
conduct trial run of the extraction unit and verify that specified parameters are attained with no abnormalities
dispose off waste materials such as failed parts/aggregates, as per organisation’s policies
fill the daily, weekly and monthly maintenance/defect sheets as per the format lay down by the organization
record all repairs carried out, time taken and unplanned tasks encountered during the maintenance activities

modules.module_title: Follow work-site health and safety measures

pcs.pc_description: follow preventive measures against firedamp, whitedamp, blackdamp etc.
use the flame safety lamp for detecting the methane gas as per Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
undertake "The Take-5 (Personal Risk Assessment)" before commencement of any work
comply with safety, health and security-related regulations/guidelines at the mine e.g. SOP for material handling in underground (U/G) mine
ensure that oil, grease, canvas or other inflammable material are stored in fire-proof receptacle
ensure that every instrument, apparatus and equipment are DGMS approved before these are used

ensure that Armoured face conveyor (AFC) and chocks must be kept in a straight line for every cycle of operations and tightened up to the setting pressure while keeping it in full contact with the roof, applicable for longwall mining
provide first aid to an injured person
follow safety precautions against spontaneous heating of the coal
operate various types of fire extinguishers to control different types of fire at worksite, if required
ensure that no person is traveling/working/staying under unsupported roof
check that roof supporting is as per Systematic Support Plan (SSP) and approved Systematic Support Rules (SSR) while undertaking work in an area
take precaution against occupational health hazards (like dust, water, mine gases etc.) due to U/G working environment
use self-rescue apparatus appropriately when required
follow Safety Management Plan (SMP) and Emergency Management Plan (EMP)
follow precautions against U/G electrical appliances
take proper care against damage and accidents while loading, transporting, dismantling and erecting of roof supports
follow appropriate SOP while working near any isolated and sealed off area of the mine
ensure that the roof and the sidewalls of the mine face (or newly exposed area of the mines) have been scaled/dressed properly
take relevant safety precautions during depillaring operation in UCM
follow appropriate safety practices while traveling on U/G haul roads, incase of post blast fumes and misfire
follow the manufacturer’s instructions for care and safe operation of mine machinery and equipment
identify the working ventilation district from line diagram of ventilation circuit to direct air to the working face
follow laid out SOP in case of alarm signal for leakage of inflammable gases
follow the process of reporting any unsafe act/condition in the working area to the concerned person
use underground mine communication system
ensure positive isolation near the work place if applicable
use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) as per the requirement
maintain hand hygiene by washing hands with alcohol based sanitisers/soap
disinfect the machine/tools before and after work/task
maintain hygiene at the work site
report any symptoms of illness to the shift- incharge
identify six directional hazards at workplace and take decisions accordingly
identify the environmental impact of mining related operations and follow steps to reduce those impact
follow the mineral conservation practices in U/G mining operations to achieve optimum ore or mineral recovery
ensure that the stowing practices produce minimum disturbance to the surface
ensure that the subgrade coal is carried out to surface and stacked separately at the earmarked place
ensure the productivity of the machine for material/fuel conservation
follow the process for collecting, storing and disposing of the hazardous material and waste (like used oil, lubricant, battery, etc.) in compliance with worksite guidelines
follow the "5-S" practice at work site like cleaning oil from ground (to avoid soil from getting damaged), etc.
